title: Crispy Spanish Fried Courgette
description: A crunchy and flavorful vegan dish made with courgette and a Spanish twist. Perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: 1. Slice the courgette into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the oil, salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and chili powder.
3. Add the courgette slices to the dish and toss to coat evenly.
4. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add the courgette slices.
5. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until crispy and golden brown.
6. Remove the courgette from the pan and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
7. Squeeze the lemon juice over the courgette and serve hot.
